import json
from tests.codex_report_status import assess_report
from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader
from triggarr.search.outcome import cycle_view
h, b = 'a'*40, 'b'*40
report = dict(schema_version='2', inspected_head_sha=h, inspected_base_sha=b, pr_url='local', scope='full diff', verdict='no-findings', summary='Reviewed full diff.', coverage=['full diff'], exclusions=[], commands_run=[dict(command='git diff',exit_code=0,purpose='inspect')], findings=[], limitations=[], review_complete=True, incomplete_reasons=[])
cases = [({},0,h,'complete'), ({},124,h,'incomplete'), ({},0,b,'incomplete'), ({'review_complete':False,'incomplete_reasons':['unfinished']},0,h,'incomplete'), ({'schema_version':'1'},0,h,'incomplete'), ({'commands_run':[]},0,h,'incomplete')]
for changes, code, current, expected in cases:
    actual=assess_report(json.dumps(report | changes),exit_code=code,expected_head=h,expected_base=b,current_head=current,attempt=1)
    assert actual.status == expected, actual
print('6 report-status cases passed')
env=Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader('triggarr/templates'),autoescape=True)
env.filters['exact_time']=env.filters['relative_time']=lambda x: ''
template=env.get_template('partials/cycle_grade.html')
for grade in ['partial','failed']:
    record=dict(grade=grade,accepted=1,failed=0,malformed_skipped=3,malformed_by_queue={'missing':2,'cutoff':1})
    view=cycle_view(record,'Radarr')
    html=template.render(app=dict(last_cycle=view,app_label='Radarr'))
    expected='Show 3 skipped records' if grade=='partial' else 'Show 2 failure reasons'
    assert expected in html
print('2 dashboard render cases passed')
